subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

He said, "I will be working on the project."

options.text: He said that he would be working on the project.
He said that he will be working on the project.
He said that he was working on the project.
He said that he would work on the project.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. He said that he would be working on the project .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of converting a sentence from **direct speech** to **indirect speech**.
 
• When converting to indirect speech, the tense of the verb in the reported clause usually changes according to the rules of sequence of tenses.
 
• In this case, the direct speech sentence uses "will," which changes to "would" in the indirect speech.
 
• The original sentence says, "He said, 'I will be working on the project.'" After conversion, it becomes, "He said that he would be working on the project."

Correct sentence: *He said that he would be working on the project.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rules for Tense Changes in Indirect Speech:**
 
 
• Present Simple → Past Simple
 
• Present Continuous → Past Continuous
 
• Will → Would
 
• Can → Could
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Direct: She said, "I am reading a book."
 
• Indirect: She said that she was reading a book.
